areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: New primary-care and emergency units address insufficient and unequal coverage, with a target set; modest share of the programme.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Full-time elementary schools built or upgraded in underserved areas; indicator and target given, but impact is small relative to total demand.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Deteriorated cultural venues and a heritage railway complex renovated, forming a cultural corridor; indicators on visitation and cultural events.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: New social-assistance centres expand coverage for vulnerable families, prioritizing dense, underserved neighbourhoods.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Integrated road, drainage, mobility and public-space interventions with objectives, indicators and targets; strongest link to the programme.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Sports fields plus squares with exercise equipment and walking tracks respond to a lack of public sports spaces; indicators achievable.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Botanical garden restoring degraded vegetation and an ecological corridor to counter ecosystem fragmentation.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Drainage works and canal requalification reduce recurrent flooding; indicators and targets on flood prevention.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Modernized cultural venues, a religious pilgrimage route, panoramic lift, pedestrian-centre revitalization and ecological tourism sites strengthen tourism.

areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: No specific actions against food insecurity; expected results from social, school and health facilities fit other areas better.

not_accepted.name: Poverty
not_accepted.reason: No specific actions against food insecurity; expected results from social, school and health facilities fit other areas better.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the programme is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
